import json,tempfile,time,sqlite3
from pathlib import Path
for p in Path(tempfile.gettempdir()).glob('xenix-agent-benchmark-parent-*'):
 if p.stat().st_mtime<time.time()-1800:continue
 for q in p.glob('*.trace.jsonl'):
  es=[json.loads(s) for s in q.read_text().splitlines()]
  if not es or es[-1]['name']=='benchmark.cell.close':continue
  op=next(e['attributes'] for e in es if e['name']=='benchmark.cell.open')
  path=Path(op['runtime_home'])/'state/xenix.db'
  print('trace age sec',round(time.time()-q.stat().st_mtime),'last event',es[-1]['name'],'offset',es[-1]['started_offset_seconds'])
  if path.exists():
   with sqlite3.connect(path.as_uri()+'?mode=ro',uri=True) as con:
    for row in con.execute('select sequence_index,kind,tool_id,result_status,substr(text,1,180) from conversation_message order by sequence_index desc limit 5'):
     print(row)
